attBesluta.text: Very happy with this purchase! The machine counts the coins, calculates the total value, and automatically sorts them by denomination into separate containers. Just pour in your mixed coins and let it do the tedious work for you. It saves time and effort and has fully met my expectations. Highly recommended!

Funciona bastante rápido y es muy cómodo de usar. Puedes ponerlo a trabajar de manera "infinita" o establecer una cantidad a la que quieres que pare. Esto viene muy bien si quieres preparar los paquetes de monedas para guardar o dar al banco, colocas la cantidad que cabe en un paquete, lo inicias y cuando llena uno, se para y te parpadea que denominación se ha completado, vacías el bote, le vuelves a dar a iniciar y sigue donde se quedó.
The controls are easy to learn and the machine organises mixed coins without extra handling. The final breakdown is convenient for bookkeeping.
I can load a useful amount at once, then review the category totals on the display. The layout of the collection bins is practical for emptying.
The sorter gives me a separate count for every coin category and keeps the trays organised. It has made routine cash verification more systematic.

These shelf brackets are phenomenal! We're using them to hold up a very heavy butcher block shelving unit, and they're so good, we bought three for each shelf, but only needed two. It's a very sturdy, solid product that I would definitely recommend.
sehr stabil, präzise gearbeitet. gleich noch ein weiteres set bestellt

Je les ai achetés car elles devaient supporter des charges lourdes. Je viens de les installer et malheureusement ce n'est pas le cas. Elles fléchissement juste avec mon poids (donc moitié moins sue prévu). De plus ne se referme pas complètement une fois repliées. Dommage même si le prix reste intéressant

The placement of the braces make it near impossible to drill the brackets into the wall at anything other than an extreme angle, not head on. It makes for a difficult install and a less than idea final placement of the screws. This needs a better design solution. The brackets are otherwise strong, and function as advertised.

Die Säule ist sehr Schön und mein Kind ist begeistert. Die erste Säule war leider Defekt. Der Support war Spitze, mir wurde Kostenfrei eine neue zugeschickt und das sehr schnell. Der Kundenservice ist Spitze! 5 Sterne von mir!
The bubbling water is mesmerizing. Keeps my children entertained for hours.
It adds a nice touch to my home office. Helps me stay calm during work.
I ordered 2 sizes. Its better looking wirhout the fish. But the bubbles are not the sames. The taller version have more small bubble.. the small one are bigs and low..

Price is reasonable and product is good, serves our purpose for the kids except that a few of the fishes don't swim up, they just stay at the bottom. It's unfortunate that no replacement of the fishes is available but they offered partial refund which is a nice gesture.
